description: Multi-hub skill publisher. Sign → Audit (placeholder) → Pack (clean tar.gz with exclude rules) → Publish to clawhub.com, skillhub.cn (Tencent Cloud), or GitHub Releases, all in one command. Pluggable adapter framework — add your own hub via a user-hook script (subprocess + JSON envelope). Single source of truth: one exclude.json, one signing pass, one package, fan out to N targets. Default target: clawhub only. Use --target all for all three real hubs, or --target user-hook:./my-script.sh for custom destinations. Triggers on: publish skill, release skill, push to skill hub, ship skill to multiple hubs, 发布 skill, 上传到 clawhub, 发布到 skillhub.cn, package only, 打包不发布.
